mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (measured as the 3-month change) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is active whenever the 3-month change in FEDFUNDS is negative, and the direction of returns is positive.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods with negative FEDFUNDS 3-month change are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.0%, it predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. The signal is active when FEDFUNDS is above 2.0%, and the direction of returns is negative.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When labor market growth (measured as 3-month PAYEMS growth) exceeds 0.5% and supply growth (measured as 3-month INDPRO growth) is negative, it predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. The signal is active when both conditions hold, and the direction of returns is positive.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of strong GDP growth (GDPC1 annualized growth > 2%), a high level of retail sales (RSAFS > 485,000) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is active when the GDP growth condition holds and RSAFS exceeds 485,000, and the direction of returns is positive.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (measured as the 3-month change) predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. The signal is active whenever the 3-month change in UNRATE is positive, and the direction of returns is negative.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in periods with positive UNRATE 3-month change are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days. The signal is active when UNRATE is above 5.0%, and the direction of returns is negative.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When supply growth (measured as 3-month INDPRO growth) is negative and housing market strength (measured as 3-month HOUST growth) exceeds 0.5%, it predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is active when both conditions hold, and the direction of returns is positive.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the annualized inflation rate (computed from CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, it predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. The signal is active when the annualized inflation rate is above 2.5%, and the direction of returns is negative.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
